heading: Tonight
text: Becoming cloudy, with showers spreading south through the Adirondacks, and east from I-89 north. Lows in the 40s west to east, a few 30s northeast. Winds northwest 10 to 15 mph this evening, diminishing to light, becoming southeast up to 10 mph west of the Green Mountains late.

heading: Tuesday
text: Heavy rain north, expanding south over the Adirondacks and Lower Greens, decreasing near and south of the MA border. Becoming scattered in the evening. Highs in the 50s, 40s east, 60s west and south. Winds south to southeast 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Rain and showers north, scattered south, diminishing west to east.Lows in the 50s, 40s northeast of I-89.Winds south to southeast 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, shifting to the northwest, late in NH.
